contract.intent: Validators (S4) — deterministic checks served in F7 (gates) + F16 (check): schema, artifact gate, append-only, leg gate, distance-to-goal as set, redaction, artifact-hash integrity. Consumes the rule registry (rules/check/rules.json) + vocab registry. Refuses judgment calls (that is the runner reviewer job) and scalar progress numbers (AC5).
acceptanceCriteria: Every rule id in the registry has an implementation (registry-integrity)
Checks: schema (vocab registry), artifact gate, append-only, leg gate (derived aggregate), distance-to-goal as a set, redaction
Artifact-hash verification: marker-stripped blob vs recorded lockSha — fail-closed on new locks
No scalar progress numbers; distance-to-goal is a set
